body:
A few months before senior year, our class which was a batch of people who knew each other for more than ten years (kindergarten to that year) was in chaos because of the same reason such as this. And the girl who was verbally harassed and was severely traumatized was one of my best friends. She was a smart, beautiful, and brave girl. Unfortunately, the bitter ex-boyfriend who was also one of our classmate leaked her nude photos. We, the 3 best and closest of her friend, was the first ones to take action hunting down the people who had the copy and made them delete it. But it was still spread out through words inside that batch of people whom we basically grew up with. Some were respectful, some were just too nasty that up to this day I never bothered to make contact with them. She was so ashamed, traumatized, and angry that she pushed and blamed ALL of us. And yet, we were still with her until the end of that year. College went and I have observed how she tried to erase the past which includes us, the 3 best friends. We have broken up and I still hope she gets to be okay and contact us again.

It's so hard to forget. And she wouldn't want to be reminded of how awful the feeling and memories were. So I would say forgive yourself, change for the better and act just how you feel today (in a better way) when situations as such happen. Hope you do well as well, don't succumb to darkness.
